name: Omni MCP
description: Query governed Omni semantic-layer metrics in plain English, search dashboards, and build Omni apps from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or other MCP clients.

skills.name: Natural Language Queries
skills.description: Picks an Omni model and topic, turns a plain-English question into a query, and returns results governed by the semantic layer.

skills.name: Multi-Step Analysis Jobs
skills.description: Submits askOmni analysis jobs, polls their status, and cancels them, for deeper questions that chain several queries together.

skills.name: Dashboard Search And Export
skills.description: Searches saved dashboards and apps, runs the saved queries they contain, and downloads a dashboard as a PNG or PDF file.

skills.name: App Editing And Rendering
skills.description: Reads, edits, and publishes Omni app drafts and renders a saved, interactive app inline with live data in the chat.

skills.name: Omni Docs Search
skills.description: Searches the official Omni documentation and returns answers with citations to how-do-I questions about using Omni.
